title: Ecological order of expression, inherited evolution and finite persistence
question: Does temporal order of identical cumulative assurance and floral-investment expression perturbations alter inherited evolution and later persistence under the same future pollinator community?

source.earlier_failure: PR #413 independent16 mutation-access-order gate FAILED; balanced-duration four-history pilot pooled effect 0; not superseded
source.parallel_protocol: PR #414 past-assurance-access 400-update future-common-evolution experiment; do not conflate or reuse cohorts

axes.matching: X, visitor match (no assigned expression perturbation)

prehistory.founder_policy: identical 48-plant full diploid founders across randomized treatment arms per history/setting/repeat

path_perturbation.type: transient phenotype-only logit offset applied inside reproductive payoff function
path_perturbation.mapping: phenotype=logistic(logit(clip(mean_diploid_alleles,epsilon,1-epsilon))+offset), epsilon=1e-8; do not overwrite genotype or inherited alleles
path_perturbation.genetic_rule: Both A and I genetic loci retain IDENTICAL mutation opportunities from t0 in all arms. Expression offset is never inherited. Matching X unchanged.
path_perturbation.caution: Equal prescribed logit-offset dose, not equal realized phenotype or equal accumulated selection across evolving genotypes
path_perturbation.dose_contract: Each arm imposes A=+0.45 logit offset in exactly 200 prehistory updates and I=-0.45 in exactly 200 updates, released identically at 300. All share same final schedule and mutation rule.
path_perturbation.randomization: Every history × nested repeat × mating setting × near/far has all 3 arms; same visitor and demographic seed identifiers are paired, not extra independent histories.

postshock.schedule: all three prehistory treatments have identical unrestricted genetic mutation and zero expression offset
postshock.sampling: sample min(8,n_alive) actual full diploid genotypes without resetting alleles; use source-history paired random streams
postshock.primary_outcome: binary occupancy after 80 updates including zero for groups extinct before transfer

estimation.nested_handling: average nested demographic repeat, both future visitor environments and all 7 log-budget weights within each history and mating setting; do not bootstrap 86,016 trajectories
estimation.primary: Within each history and setting: [(S_Afirst_far-S_Ifirst_far)-(S_Afirst_near-S_Ifirst_near)] in eight_founders_capacity8, equal weighted over 4 mating settings.
estimation.contrast_type: intention-to-treat effect of randomized expression-order protocol, not causal effect of observed spontaneous genetic threshold crossing
estimation.primary_decision: Nonzero order-protocol effect supported only if 95% visitor-history bootstrap interval excludes 0 and |pooled mean| >=0.05; either sign allowed, no post-outcome preference.
estimation.equivalence: Only if the full 95% interval lies within [-0.05,+0.05] can a bounded near-zero effect be called equivalent under this synthetic setting. Otherwise inconclusive.
mandatory: all four mating settings and history-level contrasts
pre-extinction counts, inherited genotype mean/variance, mutation availability, realized trait-threshold order
immediate maternal viable, female outcross and paternal export, never interchangeable with survival

threshold_and_pde.threshold: Measure corrected fixed-resident rare-mutant marginal payoff zero crossings separately and label them local selection thresholds, not population trait change-points.
threshold_and_pde.realized_order: Record inherited (not expression-offset) population-mean A and I at every reproductive update t0-400; classify first |genetic mean minus actual t0 founder mean|>=0.05 crossing as A_first, I_first, tie, A_only, I_only or neither. Assigned offsets are NEVER counted as inherited threshold crossings. Post-treatment crossing status must not condition primary ITT.
threshold_and_pde.pde: Optional only after separately admitted full-genotype numerical fidelity against exact no-perturbation ABM; not required for order-protocol scientific gate and not asserted validated.

stop_conditions: Design-only compiler may enumerate metadata but must not sample visitors or produce biological outcomes.
No biological production until source module and transient-expression implementation are frozen and paired tests pass.
Failure of historical independent16 confirmation remains FAIL even if this different perturbation shows an effect.
Do not merge this design into PR #414, which estimates a different historical-assurance-access treatment.
Synthetic ecological regimes and extinction stress are not natural Izu island calibration.
No claim of natural evolutionary order causality, genetic mediation or validated PDE from randomized expression protocols.
